Hello, I hope everyone is doing well. Here is a commission I requested from StormFedeR to do for me, it is not complete but with each update I will add new pages.

The story is about the Portal Master and his wife, Stealth Elf, reviewing an erotic magazine that they are making. Where the male has an open marriage with his two wives (Stealth Elf and Hex), and is trying to find who might be his third wife. He desires to have a child of his own, so his two wives agreed to let him have sex with other women. If one of those women can conceive a child, then they become the master's third wife. In the current story, Stealth and the Master are going through images for their erotic magazine, talking about all the girls and having a bit of fun on the side.

I won't spoil anything more, so you will have to wait and see what will happen.

The reason for why I wrote this specific story is to have a plot motivation for why there should feature many different female characters from the Skylanders series. Look forward to many more beautiful ladies, especially some heated action with Stealth in a bunny suit, that will be page 4 when it is available.

Also, I hope everyone enjoys the layout of the pages. I requested a frame narration (the black boarders) in order to have more story be told without covering up the artworks.
